notes:
Every Forsaken's page in Valheim Data now has a Boss Caller panel: the item, how many, and whether you offer it at the bowl or hang it on the altar's item stands - with a separate "on the way in" step where the game gates the fight (the Queen's Sealbreaker door, Kall's outer bowl). It is read straight from each altar's OfferingBowl in the game files rather than the wiki, so it reflects 1.0: the Queen takes three Seeker Soldier Trophies, Kall Fimbulbringer three Malicious Blood at the gate and three more inside. Boss Caller items link back to the boss they summon.

Best Weapon no longer stops at "any melee weapon": it spells out the weapon families (swords, axes, knives, maces, sledgehammers, spears, atgeirs, fists) and names real gear you can have by that boss's biome - Moder gets Crystal Battleaxe, Fang Spear and Silver Sword, with Fire Arrows for the fire weakness - each one clickable. When nothing exists at that tier it points at the nearest later tier instead of the strongest weapon in the game.

Also: The Elder gains his missing Black Forest biome. Asked for by Lady Emz (MegaBug 20260920-065816-54ed6c16).
